title: Shared definitions
description: Every position, rotation, scale and direction is in Blender's space: right-handed, +Z up, metres (ADR 0011).

hash.description: A Content Hash: the first 32 hex digits of a SHA-256 (ADR 0012).

sha256.description: A whole SHA-256, in lower-case hex.

node.description: A node id: its position in scene.json's node list.

map_key.description: A Map's key: the path of its Scene Bundle in the game's asset folder, without the file extension, such as map/scene/1f.

times_of_day.description: Times of Day, each once, in their set's order.

quat.description: A unit quaternion as [w, x, y, z], Blender's order.

color.description: [r, g, b, a] exactly as the game serialized it, with no colour space conversion.
